description: This file defines the JobCategory entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapped with Doctrine ORM annotations. It represents a job category with properties for id and name, including getter and setter methods.

classes.name: JobCategory
classes.description: Entity class representing a Job Category in the HRM system, mapped with Doctrine ORM annotations, containing id and name properties with corresponding accessor methods.
